Permanent source checks

Source: vignettes/articles/contributor-tools-checks-readme.Rmd
contributor-tools-checks-readme.Rmd

Contributing · Object model · Discovery walkthrough · Object fields

These checks validate the current implementation without loading an old package, old implementation, historical expected output or refactor evidence archive. They run in routine CI alongside the self-contained package tests.

  • test-native-components.R: direct effect/score/tail mathematics.
  • test-sampling-ownership.R: controlled pointer-boundary failures.
  • test-count-ownership.R: controlled count allocation/error paths and nonmutation.
  • test-dispersion-exceptions.R: current numerical-versus-system exception policy.
  • test-result-ownership.R: current result-buffer lifetime, controlled failures and negative control. Unfailed current calls are repeatability controls, not numerical-reference claims; package/component tests supply mathematical checks.

Each source probe compiles test-only instrumentation in a temporary directory. No production failure-injection hook is added. These certify their declared buffer/error boundaries, not every Rcpp allocation or actual operating-system OOM. This directory is excluded from the source package by .Rbuildignore.

Historical equality checks, including the original forms of mixed probes, live in tools/refactor/ and have no CI entry point. See its README.md.
